structure.unit: Administration of Chapter; Sale, Etc., of Condominium Units

law.catch_line: Exemptions from certain provisions of article

text.section: In cases of dispositions in a condominium where all units are restricted to nonresidential use, the provisions of §§ 55.1-1974 through 55.1-1983 shall not apply, unless the method of offer or disposition is adopted for the purpose of evasion of this chapter.
